name: Harper Mobile Spike
description: Instrumented on-device spike measuring whether joplin.settings.setValue is safe during mobile editing. Engine-free (no WASM); the content script buffers its whole trail silently, then flushes it to a settings value at t=45s and t=90s (settings writes) and only at t=135s triggers the one known-lethal data.put note-write. If the editor survives both settings writes but dies at the note write, settings are proven safe for the mobile v1 design. Not for publication.
author: pmslava
